'''''Convergence''''' was a [[Convergence Tactical Assault Vehicle]] during the [[Sith civil war]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It was built by mechanics and engineers of [[Daiman]], whose constant indecision led to countless redesigns. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Narsk Ka'hane]] was sent by [[Odion]] to learn the secrets of the ship.
